Package com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.input

@ParametersAreNonnullByDefault package com.sbancuz.offscreen.window.input
Native event capture, consumable frame input, and temporary legacy input views.

SDL events identify their target window. Mouse positions are relative to that window in SDL window coordinates. Window capture copies event data before native storage expires. Frame conversion produces Minecraft GUI coordinates; a scoped LWJGLY bridge converts back to drawable pixels when legacy input code asks for them. SDL scancodes, SDL key symbols, and LWJGL key codes are separate identifiers and must not be mixed. Unicode text is delivered separately from physical key transitions.
